fieldNotes.truckGate: RDC #5643. Truck yard entrance at the SW/W corner off the road; driver reviews explicitly mention a guard shack and a gate where trucks check in.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed by web reviews: drivers describe 'friendly staff at the guard shack' and report waiting 'over an hour to enter' at the gate — a staffed guard booth with significant check-in queuing.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Driver reviews report 1+ hour gate waits; the gate is close to public roads with limited stacking room, so a truck queue spills toward the road — backup-sensitive.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Long gate waits imply trucks stage outside/before the gate; paved apron and road shoulder available for waiting.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dense dock-door rhythm with trailers backed in along the long south face (and north) of the RDC building — well over 100 doors.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer drop yard with many rows of parked trailers on the south side of the building.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs E-W through the property, immediately south of the main trailer drop yard — the site is rail-adjacent/rail-served.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Most dock activity concentrated on the south face; whether shipping and receiving use physically separate banks is not clearly resolved — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Tolleson is inside the Phoenix metro's continuous urban fabric — residential subdivisions directly north of the RDC, dense industrial all around — judged Urban.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated; exact lane count at the gate not fully resolved.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Approximate count from z16-z19 imagery across dock face and drop yard.
